summary: Applies a 2x2 linear transform to four packed input pairs using 3DNow! intrinsics. The four coefficients of the 2x2 matrix in a2 (two __m64) are splatted into replicated pairs (v4, v6 from a2[0]; v7, v8 from a2[1]), then each output pair is the sum of four a3 pairs weighted by those coefficients: output[0] uses a3[0]/a3[2]/a3[4]/a3[6], output[1] uses a3[1]/a3[3]/a3[5]/a3[7]. Results are stored to a1[0] and a1[1]. MMX state is cleared with _m_femms at entry and exit, and the output buffer a1 is returned. The packet's ABI name Matrix2x2_3DNow is LEGACY-trusted.

operations.description: Clear MMX/3DNow state via _m_femms at entry.
Splat the two float coefficients of a2[0] (m00, m01) into replicated pairs v4 and v6 via punpckldq/punpckhdq.
Splat the two float coefficients of a2[1] (m10, m11) into replicated pairs v7 and v8 via punpckldq/punpckhdq.
Compute output pair 1 as v4*a3[1] + v6*a3[3] + v7*a3[5] + v8*a3[7] using pfmul and pfadd.
Compute output pair 0 as v4*a3[0] + v6*a3[2] + v7*a3[4] + v8*a3[6] using pfmul and pfadd.
Store output pair 0 into a1 at offset 0x0.
Store output pair 1 into a1 at offset 0x8.
Clear MMX/3DNow state via _m_femms at exit.
Return the output buffer pointer a1.
